attributes.action: no social media curfew for 16 and 17 year olds
attributes.additional_details: This petition is to get the government to not put a curfew on social media for 16 and 17 year olds. if they can get a job, join the army, consent to sex and have a child and drive, they should be able to decide when they want to use there phone. Parents should make the decision of time limits with parental controls not the government
attributes.background: Scrap the idea of a curfew for social media for 16-17 year olds as it is absolutely ridiculous. that is a parental decision not a government decision.16 and 17 years olds can drive, consent to sex, join the army and get a job but can’t decide when they can use there phone? This is not your descison.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Do not introduce social media curfew for 16 & 17 year olds" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772675
